author: Rivers Upchurch
title: Hawg Jaws BBQ coming to Hinton - NewsBreak
text:
By Rivers Upchurch Photo courtesy: Hinton Railroad Days Facebook page ,
2 hours ago
HINTON, WV (WVNS) – Fans of traditional southern barbecue are about to be riding a little higher on the hog!
Hawg Jaws BBQ, a new barbecue restaurant, will hold its grand opening in Hinton on Saturday, April 18, 2026. The restaurant will be open from 11:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. to give customers a chance to try their signature pulled pork, brisket, chicken and sausage.
Hawg Jaws advertises “true southern BBQ,” and claims that their food is prepared “the old school way with wood and time.”
Alderson elementary schooler and state champion turns heads on national archery scene Following the grand opening, the restaurant will be open from 11:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. Wednesdays through Saturdays, from 1:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m. on Sundays, and it will be closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.
Hawg Jaws is located at 846 Hinton Bypass, Hinton, WV.
You can find more information on their Facebook page.
